name: Fool
overview: Scripture reveals that fools are characterized by a rejection of God, as seen in Psalms where fools declare in their hearts that there is no God, resulting in corruption and abominable works. The fear of the LORD is foundational to knowledge, yet fools despise wisdom and instruction, leading to their downfall and affliction due to transgression and iniquity. God's hatred for workers of iniquity and His rejection of the foolish affirm the spiritual peril of folly, which also includes blaspheming His name as noted in the Psalms.
